situation.en: 73 armed incidents were reported in Iran in the past seven days, roughly as many as the week before. Most were armed clashs (53%), followed by armed assaults (21%). 20 of them were carried by two or more outlets. The most reported locations over the past month were Tehran, Minab and Kurdistan. UCDP lists 3 active armed conflicts here, the oldest dating from 1972. The most widely covered story this week: “Days of Deadly Houthi Attacks Show Saudi Arabia’s Vulnerabilities” (The New York Times, 2 outlets).
situation.nb: 73 væpnede hendelser ble meldt i Iran de siste sju dagene, omtrent like mange som uken før. Flest gjaldt væpnet sammenstøt (53 prosent), deretter væpnet angrep (21 prosent). 20 av dem ble omtalt av to eller flere medier. De mest omtalte stedene den siste måneden var Tehran, Minab og Kurdistan. UCDP fører 3 aktive væpnede konflikter her, den eldste fra 1972. Mest omtalte sak denne uken: «Days of Deadly Houthi Attacks Show Saudi Arabia’s Vulnerabilities» (The New York Times, 2 medier).
